entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Kasumi helped me through this special[n]regimen several times.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: It gets tough after a while. Your limbs[n]start feeling heavier the longer you[n]keep them up.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Whenever we did this before, all I could[n]focus on was how well Kasumi was doing.[n]And how much I wanted to stop.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Kasumi was probably so disappointed in[n]me... I got tired out so quick...
Maybe.
Who knows?
Were you frustrated?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I know I disappointed myself, at least.[n]Kasumi never doubted herself for a[n]second... And then there's me...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: She never said it. But I was disappointed[n]in myself, at least.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: She never doubted herself for a second.[n]And then there's me...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: It's not that I was frustrated. I just felt[n]so miserable that I couldn't match up[n]to Kasumi.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: She never doubted herself for a second.[n]And then there's me...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Oh... I think it's almost time for my coach[n]to show up. I'm kind of nervous.
Is she scary?
Is she strict?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: You could say that. She's tough on us,[n]but she's a great mentor.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: She's been helping Kasumi and me for[n]a long time.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Even through all my stupid delusions as[n]Kasumi, she never stopped helping me...[n]I don't know what I'd do without her.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Hello, Coach Hiraguchi!

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: Sumire...?

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: Maybe it's just my imagination, but...[n]you seem like your old self again.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Y-Yes... I'm sorry I worried you.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Um, I've... I've been running away from[n]what happened to my sister.

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: ...So you realized.

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: Are you okay now?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'm not totally back to my normal self,[n]but I'm working towards a new goal.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I want to be the best in the world...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: So now, I'm going to do what I can[n]as Sumire.

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: By the way, who's this?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Oh, um, this is my senpai from school.[n]We both came here for a lesson.

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: Oh, so you're...

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: Fine. Let's have you go first, Sumire.[n]You can start with your combination.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Y-Yes, ma'am!

entries.speaker: Tall Man
entries.en: She's got some amazing moves...

entries.speaker: Fit Man
entries.en: That was so freakin' fast... She's really[n]got those aggressive moves down.

entries.speaker: Fit Man
entries.en: She really is just like her sister...

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: Okay, you can take a break. We'll do[n]some more later.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Phew... hah... Th-Thank you very much!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Um, Coach Hiraguchi... Thanks for all[n]your help today.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: So... how did I do? I tried to put some[n]real force into that combination.

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: You said you were going to perform as[n]Sumire this time. I didn't see that at all.

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: All I saw out there was Kasumi...[n]or a shadow of her, at least.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Wh-What...?

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: Kasumi defined her performance by her[n]boldness, yes. But that's not something[n]you can appropriate for yourself.

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: It came from the energy within her.[n]That's what made her Kasumi.

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: I told you to think about who you really[n]are. Seems like you still don't understand[n]what I meant.

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: You need to stop hiding behind Kasumi.

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: If you keep denying yourself like this,[n]how can she still call you her rival?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Huh!? What's that supposed to...?

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: I never wanted to draw attention to it,[n]but Kasumi had a very competitive streak.[n]She hated to lose.

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: She would always tell me...

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: She was so jealous of her little sister, and[n]her delicate, graceful style. "I can't lose to[n]her," she said. She wanted you to see that.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: She... She said that?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Th-That's... impossible. Kasumi could do[n]anything, and I... I was nothing...

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: I've said all I wanted to say. But I suggest[n]you think a little harder about it.

entries.speaker: Coach Hiraguchi
entries.en: Okay, it's your turn now! Get ready!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: *Siiigh...*
You okay?[clr 27]
That was a big sigh.
She's a real taskmaster.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Thank you, but I'm fine. I noticed she[n]was quite impressed with your physical[n]abilities.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Compared to you, though... I was pitiful.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Sorry... I couldn't help it.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'm sorry you had to see that mess[n]earlier.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Oh, she's actually being nicer than usual.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But I'm sorry you had to see that mess[n]earlier.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Me, graceful...?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Now that I think about it, I guess that's[n]the one thing my coach used to[n]compliment me on.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But even with that, I couldn't match[n]Kasumi's performance at all.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: And now she says Kasumi saw me as[n]a rival...? I don't believe it.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I mean, all I was doing was imitating her.[n]Even since the beginning, I was just[n]following Kasumi...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: That was fine in the beginning. I loved[n]being with Kasumi, and it was fun.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But ever since I started noticing the[n]difference in our gymnastic skills,[n]one thing became clear...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'll always be someone less than Kasumi.[n]I'm just worthless after all...
That isn't true.[clr 27]
You need more confidence.
That's just a mental block.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Thank you for saying that. You're very[n]kind, Senpai.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Well, yes... Anyone can see that.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: You think so? I just don't understand.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Still, something occurred to me when[n]Coach told me what Kasumi said.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I realized... Just like she wanted to show[n]me what she could do, I still want you[n]to see my own abilities.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: You remember? Like when I tried to[n]show off back at the batting cages?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Oh... Maybe that's what I need to chase.[n]Maybe that feeling can help me get[n]some confidence!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: It sounds like even Kasumi liked my[n]more subtle and delicate moves, so...[n]If I mix it with her aggressive style...
It'll be like a duet.
You'll become stronger.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Right? Maybe I'll be able to step up[n]my routine!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: If the key here is showing you what I[n]can do, then I just need you to watch[n]me again...!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Senpai, will you go out with me again?
Of course.[clr 27]
I could watch you forever.
Another love confession?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Th-Thank you so much. As long as I've[n]got you behind me, Senpai, I can keep[n]moving forward.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: U-Um, [fName]-senpai... You're[n]going to make me blush if you say[n]things like that.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But thank you... I'll be relying on you.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Wh... Wh-What!? I-I mean, um...[n]Love!? I-I didn't mean—

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I-I mean, um, I wasn't—I didn't mean to—[n]I was just hoping to get your help,[n]a-and—

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Wait... Senpai, are you just messing[n]with me!? Ugh...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But I hope you know, I really will be[n]relying on you.
I can sense a deep bond[n]of trust from Sumire...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'll think about what else I can do.[n]When I figure it out, I'll let you know.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Oh, is it time already? Let's get going.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Thank you so much for today.[n]I'll see you next time.
